components.name: Parcel Strip Band
components.description: One block band and its lot: label row above, hatched lots, orange matched lot, point on the lot band.

narrative.overview:
AWS address space is surveyed land. A lookup is answered the way a land registry answers a parcel query: by drawing which lot, inside which larger block, contains the address, to scale. The interface is a drafting sheet on a cool film ground, ruled in 1px survey ink, with one survey-orange mark for the point in question and sage for the lots that exist. Everything else is the register: numbered lots, mono figures, plain labels.

Density is operational, not decorative. The reader is mid-task next to a terminal or a firewall console, so the answer sits at the top left, the plat sits beside it, and the lot register runs full width below. Hierarchy comes from ruling weight (ink rules divide sections, pale rules divide rows), from type weight, and from the one reserved color, never from cards, shadows or tinted panels stacked on each other.

The system refuses the category default of a search bar floating over an undifferentiated table. Neutrals are a fixed tonal ramp; linework is 1px; lots are hatched or tinted, never shadowed.
keyCharacteristics: Cool drafting-film ground (not cream) with survey-ink linework, and a night-ink dark theme on the same roles.
Survey orange is reserved for the queried point and the matched lot, nothing else.
Every prefix, address, count and figure is set in a tabular, slashed-zero mono.
Sections are divided by full-width 1px ink rules; rows by pale rules.
Flat: depth is drawn (hatching, outlined windows, dashed fans), not cast.

rules.name: The Survey Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange marks exactly two things: the queried point and the matched lot (with its "Matched lot" label, its row in the register, and the lot of the selected bulk row, which is the one drawn on the plat). Fills use mark; orange text uses mark-ink, which lifts to mark-ink-dark on the night ground. If something orange is neither the point nor the lot, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Sage Is Published Rule
rules.body: Sage means "AWS publishes this": lots, regions, stamped success. Sage never marks the query and never decorates.

rules.name: The Fixed Ramp Rule
rules.body: Neutrals come from the ramp (ground, paper, ink, ink-2, rule, rule-2). Do not invent intermediate greys; a new surface picks a ramp step. The one sanctioned derivative is the 85% ink hover on ink fills.

rules.name: The Mono Figure Rule
rules.body: Every prefix, address, count, region code and figure is mono, with tabular numerals and a slashed zero. Words are sans.

rules.name: The Region Label Rule
rules.body: Region labels are mono 12px in a 1px sage border, at least 8.5rem wide, and never shrink or wrap.

rules.name: The Whole Cell Rule
rules.body: Index grids reflow in whole ruled cells; a cell never narrows below its minimum to fit one more column.

rules.name: The Drawn Depth Rule
rules.body: Lots are hatched or tinted, never shadowed. The single permitted shadow belongs to a popover that is open over other content (select list, Copy as menu).

rules.name: The Label Row Rule
rules.body: Plat labels sit in a row above each band, never inside it. A tick label that would collide with a leader line or a neighbour is dropped, never overlapped or shrunk.

rules.name: The One Lot Rule
rules.body: Records that share a prefix are one lot. Group them; list their services and regions together; never repeat the prefix as separate answers.

rules.name: The Numbered Lot Rule
rules.body: Register and bulk rows are numbered as lots, in sage ink; register numbers continue across pages.

rules.name: The Stamp In Place Rule
rules.body: Copy, Copy as and export report their state in the control that was pressed, in sage ink or danger, and then return to rest. No toasts.

dos: Do reserve survey orange for the queried point and the matched lot, its "Matched lot" label, its register row and the selected bulk row's lot; fills in mark, text in mark-ink (the lifted mark-ink-dark on the night ground).
Do group records that share a prefix into one lot.
Do put plat labels in a row above each band and drop a colliding tick label rather than overlap it.
Do number register and bulk rows as lots, in sage ink.
Do set every prefix, address, count and figure in the mono with tabular numerals and slashed zero.
Do open each section with a full-width 1px ink rule and a headline paired with its mono count.
Do keep region labels at their full width (8.5rem minimum, no wrap) and let index grids reflow in whole cells.
Do stamp copy, Copy as and export results in place.
donts: Don't use orange for links, hovers, focus, headings, badges or any status other than the point and the matched lot.
Don't cast shadows on cards, bands, lots or rows; open popovers (select list, Copy as menu) are the only shadow.
Don't set labels or figures inside a plat band, and don't scale the plat down so its text shrinks.
Don't introduce warm or cream grounds, or greys outside the fixed neutral ramp.
Don't use uppercase tracked labels outside the plat label row.
Don't use corners larger than 4px on surfaces or controls.
